name: Listicle Writing
description: Writes numbered listicle articles with consistent item structure, intro framing, and a conclusion that ties items together. Use when the user wants a list-format blog post, a "top N" article, a roundup post, or asks for content in numbered list format. Do NOT use for step-by-step instructions (use `how-to-guide`), general blog posts (use `blog-post-writing`), or editorial calendars (use `editorial-calendar`).
